\begin{equation}
y=f(x).
\end{equation}

\section*{4. Evidence boundary}

% Optional claim/evidence index: see docs/claim-evidence-index.md. When adopted,
% read the canonical evidence before summarizing material claim locators,
% changed dependencies, contradictions and unresolved checks here. Preserve

% This PDF remains the human review document; no second Markdown review is due.

\supported{List only conclusions established by this gate.}

\notsupported{List crossings, mechanisms, regimes, validation levels, novelty,
publication, or disclosure conclusions that remain outside the evidence.}

\clearpage
\section*{5. Critic verdict and next gate}
\thispagestyle{fancy}

Lead each objection with one short bold challenge sentence, followed
immediately by the bounded evidence-based response. For example:

\textbf{``State the strongest alternative explanation.''} Explain what the
current evidence can and cannot exclude, then name the cheapest discriminating
next action.

\section*{6. Owner decisions}

\begin{enumerate}[itemsep=5pt,leftmargin=2em]
\item Approve or revise the implementation and verification record.
\item Approve or revise the numerical or analytic verdict.
\item Approve or revise the evidence boundary.
\item Authorize or reject the exact next bounded action.
\end{enumerate}

\textbf{Recommended selections:} map every numbered item to \emph{approve},
\emph{revise}, \emph{reject}, \emph{pause}, or one named option.

\textbf{Reason and scope effect:} state the shortest evidence-based reason,
the work opened by this recommendation, the work that remains closed, and the
main uncertainty or tradeoff. If no scientific option is yet defensible,
recommend pausing for one named missing piece of evidence.
